rows.reply_en:
Hi,

Thank you for reaching out. The Roosterly mobile app requires iOS 16 or later (and Android 10 or later). Because your iPhone 8 is running iOS 15, the app is unfortunately not supported on this operating system version. Updating your device to iOS 16 or later will resolve the crashes.

Team Roosterly
rows.nordavo_reason: English ticket. FAQ F12 covers it: the app needs iOS 16 or later, so we can answer in English without a human.
rows.agent_reason: The crash is caused by an unsupported operating system version (iOS 15), which is explicitly explained in FAQ F12.

rows.reply_en: Hello, you can change the VAT number for future invoices yourself in the app via Instellingen → Bedrijfsgegevens (Settings → Company details). Best regards, Team Roosterly
rows.nordavo_reason: How to change invoice details is in FAQ F06. Reply in Dutch.
rows.agent_reason: The customer is asking how to update their VAT number for future invoices. This is fully explained in FAQ F06.

rows.nordavo_reason: Refund request ('terugkrijgen' = get back). Client rule: refunds always go to a human.
rows.agent_reason: The ticket requests a refund for a period when the business was closed. Per support policy rules, refund requests must always be handed off to a human.

rows.reply_en:
Hi,

You can swap a shift by opening the shift in the app and tapping "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can then accept the swap. Once accepted, the manager approves the swap under Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests).

Kind regards,
Team Roosterly
rows.nordavo_reason: Dutch how-to question about swapping shifts, answered by FAQ F03. Reply in Dutch.
rows.agent_reason: This is a standard how-to question about shift swapping fully covered by FAQ F03. Action is reply and priority is P4.

rows.reply_en: Hello, thank you for your suggestion! You can view ideas and feature requests and vote on them via our public roadmap at roadmap.roosterly.nl. Unfortunately, we cannot promise a delivery date for individual requests. Kind regards, Team Roosterly
rows.nordavo_reason: Feature request (Google Calendar sync). Acknowledge in Dutch and point to the roadmap (F10).
rows.agent_reason: The customer asks for a new Google Agenda feature. According to F10, feature requests are acknowledged and directed to the roadmap.

rows.reply_en: Dear, The Plus plan costs €6 per active employee per month (excluding VAT). For 25 employees, that is €150 per month (excluding VAT). You can upgrade at any time under Instellingen → Abonnement (Settings → Subscription). The new price applies from the next invoice. Kind regards, Team Roosterly

rows.agent_reason: The user is asking about the pricing of the Plus plan for 25 employees, which is fully answered by F05 (€6/employee/month excl. VAT).
